entities.name: Islamic Marriage Contract (Nikah)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Islamic nikah is a civil contract (not a sacrament) requiring the bride's consent, witnesses, and mahr (a mandatory gift from groom to bride that remains her property). The Quran granted women inheritance and property rights within marriage — revolutionary for 7th-century Arabia. Polygyny is permitted (up to 4 wives) with conditions of equal treatment.
